principles: Tech-blue accent on a light neutral base with a deep-navy navigation rail.
No decorative borders: surfaces are separated by tonal fill, never by 1px lines.
Flat: no drop shadows, no gradients, no glossy overlays.
Depth comes from surface tint and scrim only.
Focus visibility is preserved with an outline, not a border.

themeMode.rule: Every client exposes the same three choices and resolves `system` through the platform appearance setting; dark is a complete token set, not an inversion filter.

iconColors.rule: Icon colours are foreground tokens. A border, outline, surface, or transparent token MUST NOT be used as an icon colour.

platformNotes.pc: Deep-navy rail, white surfaces, blue active states. Remove border and shadow utilities inside the workbench shell; keep focus outlines.
platformNotes.h5: Light tech-blue shell replaces the previous dark shell. Page background #F4F7FC, cards #FFFFFF, tab bar #FFFFFF with blue active item.
platformNotes.miniProgram: Light tech-blue shell. Tab bar and cards flat; no wxss border or box-shadow rules; active color #165DFF.
platformNotes.flutter: Material 3 with ColorScheme.fromSeed(#165DFF) for light and the `dark` token set for dark; follow the platform brightness; elevation 0 everywhere; dividerColor transparent; filled inputs; no Card elevation. Icon colours must resolve from `iconColors` in both schemes.
platformNotes.harmony: ArkUI tokens use the same colors; borderWidth 0, shadow none, background #F4F7FC and rail #0A1B3D.

rules: No visible 1px decorative border may remain on shell, cards, inputs, tab bars, modals, or list rows.
No box-shadow/elevation may remain on surfaces; dialogs may use only the scrim.
No gradient background may remain in shell or primary surfaces.
Primary actions use #165DFF with #FFFFFF text; focus outlines remain visible.
All clients must still pass their own typecheck/build/analyze gates.
